== English Reflections III comparison ==
Decipher’s printed Effect takes a qualifying door card into hand once per turn. The January 2002 publisher supplement changes this to deploying the qualifying card directly from Reserve during the owner’s deploy phase. The supplement gives 5 February as its effective date. The Endor scout modifier and Alter immunity remain.
